examples.user_query: Can you list the columns in the 'CustomerInsights' DataModel?

examples.user_query: I need to check the columns in the 'MarketingPerformance' DataModel for a report. Can you help?

description: Identify unused columns in a DataModel by comparing all columns against dashboard usage.

datamodel_name.description: The name of the DataModel to analyze.

examples.user_query: Which columns in the 'Sales_Analytics' DataModel are not being used in any dashboards?
examples.notes: This call checks the 'Sales_Analytics' DataModel and identifies columns that are not referenced in any associated dashboards. Useful for cleaning up unused fields.

examples.user_query: Can you find unused columns in the 'Customer_Insights' DataModel?
examples.notes: This call analyzes the 'Customer_Insights' DataModel to determine which columns are not utilized in any dashboards. Ideal for optimizing the DataModel structure.

examples.user_query: I want to know if there are any unused columns in the 'Marketing_Performance' DataModel.
examples.notes: This call identifies unused columns in the 'Marketing_Performance' DataModel by comparing them against dashboard usage. Helps in maintaining a lean and efficient DataModel.

description: Run unused-column analysis for one or more data models and return a

datamodels.description: One or more data model references to analyze. Each reference can be: - a data model ID, or - a data model title (name). At least one data model reference is required. At runtime this parameter is tolerant of a single string and will normalize it to a one-element list.

examples.user_query: Which columns are unused in the 'Sales Data' and 'Marketing Analytics' data models?
examples.notes: This call analyzes the 'Sales Data' and 'Marketing Analytics' data models to identify columns that are not being used.

examples.user_query: Find unused columns in the data model with ID 'dm_12345'.
examples.notes: This call checks the data model with ID 'dm_12345' for any unused columns. Useful when you know the specific ID of the data model.

examples.user_query: Run unused-column analysis on multiple data models: 'dm_67890', 'Customer Insights', and 'dm_54321'.
examples.notes: This call processes three data models—two by ID and one by title—to identify unused columns across all of them.
